item.title: Timeline of Mars Science Laboratory
item.description: The Mars Science Laboratory and its rover, Curiosity, were launched from Earth on 26 November 2011. As of November 25, 2026, Curiosity has been in Gale Crater on the planet Mars for 5085 sols (5224 total days; 14 years, 111 days) since landing on 6 August 2012. (See Current status.)
